paragraphs: Illuminex AI applies artificial intelligence to inspection work on airfields. The company says it works with industry, government and academia on human-in-the-loop automation meant to increase safety and efficiency in critical infrastructure operations and maintenance.

One capability identifies and logs foreign object debris across runways, taxiways and aprons. Another detects fence damage, breaches and signage integrity issues. Operators are given real-time situational awareness and offset guidance to help them hold required clearances. Winter work is covered by measuring and mapping snowbank profiles. A product listed as coming soon maps runway surface conditions to support maintenance planning.

The team is described as a blend of engineers, technologists, entrepreneurs and industry specialists. Executive experience is listed in finance, non-destructive testing and inspection, AI, and advanced physical process modeling. A testimonial on the home page speaks to investing in technology to improve operational efficiency at Toronto Pearson. A 60 day pilot sign-up is offered on the same page.
